        frame[15] = 0

        frame[18:20] = b'\\x11\\x11'
        frame[20:22] = b'\\x40\\x00'
        frame[22] = 64
        frame[23] = 17
        frame[26:30] = sip
        frame[30:34] = dip
        frame[34:36] = b'\\x12\\xb7'
        frame[36:38] = b'\\x12\\xb7'
        frame[38:40] = struct.pack('!H', udp_len)
        frame[42] = 0x11 if ack else 0x04
        frame[44:46] = b'\\xff\\xff'
        frame[46:50] = qpn
        frame[50] = 0 if ack else 0x80
        frame[24:26] = struct.pack('!H', ip_checksum(bytes(frame[14:34])))
        crc = bytearray(b'\\xff' * 8 + bytes(frame[14:50]))

        crc[16] = 0xFF
        crc[18:20] = b'\\xff\\xff'
        crc[34:36] = b'\\xff\\xff'
